newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania's depleted under-21s soccer squad returns.
newsitem.headline: Albania's depleted under-21s soccer squad returns.

text.p: Albania's depleted under-21s soccer squad returned home on Friday with the coach expressing sympathy with players who sought asylum in Spain to avoid near-anarchy at home.
Seven players and a trainer remained in Spain after playing matches there against Ukraine and Germany, Spanish authorities said.

"They decided to stay in Spain only because they want to play football," said coach Sulejman Mema on arrival at Tirana airport, guarded by troops and armed personnel carriers after last month's armed insurrection.
"Everyone decided on his own...Two of the players already have contracts with Eintracht Frankfurt and two others will go to Switzerland to negotiate," he said.

Albania's main soccer league has not played since late January and Mema said players could not afford such long lay-offs. "If these boys don't continue to train I don't see any soccer future for them," he said.
His team lost 0-3 to Ukraine and 0-4 to Germany in Spain, chosen as an alternative venue because Albania was too lawless to host the games.
